hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight

rules: Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
Ensure tight letter spacing on all headings > 32px.
Line height must be tight (leading-none) for headers, loose (leading-relaxed) for body text.
Never center align body text; left-align dense content for reading flow.
Use stark white or 10% grey for backgrounds to maintain objective clarity.
Primary brand color (International Klein Blue) should be used strictly for primary CTAs and active states.
Red accent is reserved exclusively for recording states, active microphone, and destructive actions.
Ensure all text meets a minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio against backgrounds.
Hover states must be a lighter hue of the active state and explicitly set text colors.

structure.app_layout: Split view: Persistent left sidebar (250px) for history/dictionary, Main right pane for the editor and recording controls.
structure.editor_view: Generous spacing (p-8 to p-12). Left-aligned text to optimize readability for long transcriptions.
structure.grid_system: The Control Room Grid: High density for metrics, tight gaps (gap-4). But for the editor, use a single max-w-4xl column centered within the main pane.

surfaces.editor_container: Grid Borders (Technical Look): Flat background, 1px solid border (#E4E4E7), no shadow. Content scrolls internally.
surfaces.floating_actions: Glassmorphism (Crystal): backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, 1px inner border (border-white/40), subtle diffuse shadow for the floating command bar or recording controls.

components.buttons: Sharp corners or max 4px radius. High contrast. Primary: bg-[#002FA7] text-white. Recording CTA: bg-[#EF4444] text-white with pulse animation.
components.cards: Flat, 1px border-border/40, no shadows by default. Hover adds slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.
components.forms_and_inputs: Use Shadcn UI (Input, Textarea, Select, Switch). Customize to have crisp edges (rounded-sm) and distinct focus states (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#002FA7]).
components.modals_dialogs: Use Shadcn Dialog for the Personal Dictionary and Settings. Dark overlay (bg-black/20 backdrop-blur-sm).
components.transcription_editor: A custom text area that highlights the current word being spoken (using the primary brand color for the active word, and secondary text for pending text). Supports click-to-edit.

motion_and_interactions.recording_state: Pulsing red dot or dynamic SVG audio waveform animation when microphone is active.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade-in with slight upward stagger (10px translateY) for lists (like history items).
rules: Keep animations functional, not decorative. Use micro-interactions for feedback on buttons and recording toggles.

requirements: All interactive elements MUST have clear focus states with high contrast.
Use semantic HTML (main, aside, nav, article).
All key informational and interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='record-button').

icons_and_assets.style: Regular or Duotone weight, conveying a professional, technical aesthetic.

image_urls.description: Minimalist glowing audio waveform on a stark white background with a red accent. Use this in the landing page hero section or empty state backgrounds.
Man sitting at a desk with a computer. Use for the marketing page's 'Made for Professionals' section.

rules: Never use placeholder URLs. Always use the images provided above.
Apply a maximum overlay of bg-white/20 over images if text contrast is needed in light mode.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize Tailwind with the provided color palette and fonts (Outfit, IBM Plex Sans).
Build the UI focusing on a split-pane layout for the web app: Sidebar for history/dictionary, Main Editor for live transcription.
Implement real-time visual feedback for the recording state (e.g., a pulsing red indicator or animated waveform).
The text editor should feel like a premium writing tool (generous line height, distraction-free).
Use Shadcn UI for dialogs, dropdowns, and form elements, stripping out aggressive border radii to match the Swiss minimalist aesthetic (max rounded-sm).
Ensure all buttons and inputs have the required data-testid attributes.
